item.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
item.description: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us
item.content:encoded:

item.title: United Nations report highlights significant increase in U.S. climate pollution
item.description: The U.S. is the only major economy where planet-warming pollution dramatically increased last year. The United Nations warns the planet is on track for catastrophic warming.

item.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
